title: LOGO TEE

productDescription.text:
Limited Edition of 50 Units Till the End of Time
Heavyweight 100% Organic Cotton 240GSM Jersey Drop Shoulder Tee 

Front screen-printed design

Wide crewneck

16 singles

Machine washable, 30 degrees delicate

To avoid shrinkage, do not machine dry!

Made in USA, Palestine, Israel, China, Turkey, Cannan

Please notice the brown shirt is oversized, wide and with a drop shoulder.
